As of late December 2025, the AI landscape is dominated by a rapid succession of flagship releases, with GLM4.7, Grok 4.1, GPT5.2, and Gemini 3 representing the stateoftheart in reasoning, coding, and multimodal performance.[1][2][3]

 Model Performance and Rankings
The current frontier models are separated by specialized strengths rather than a single dominant leader. GPT5.2 and Gemini 3 currently lead in general reasoning and knowledge work, while GLM4.7 and Grok 4.1 have carved out niches in opensource coding and emotional intelligence, respectively.[4][2][5]

| Feature | GLM4.7 | Grok 4.1 | GPT5.2 | Gemini 3 |
| : | : | : | : | : |
| Release Date | Dec 22, 2025 [1] | Nov 17, 2025 [2] | Dec 11, 2025 [2] | Nov 18, 2025 [2] |
| Key Strength | Opensource SOTA coding [3] | Emotional Intelligence (EQ) [4] | Professional Knowledge Work [2] | Multimodality & Integration [5] |
| Specialty | Agentic workflows [6] | Realtime social data [4] | Agentic coding (SWEBench) [5] | Massive context & math [7] |
| Accessibility | Openweight available [8] | X (formerly Twitter) Premium [9] | ChatGPT Plus / API [10] | Google Ecosystem / Vertex [2] |

 Specialized Capabilities
 GLM4.7 (Zhipu AI): Released on December 22, 2025, it is positioned as a highend openweight foundation model. It specializes in agentic coding, meaning it can autonomously plan and execute multistep development tasks, and it has set new stateoftheart benchmarks for opensource models in reasoning and longcontext analysis.[3][6][11][8]
 Grok 4.1 (xAI): Launched in midNovember, Grok 4.1 excels in "social intelligence," scoring significantly higher on EQ benchmarks like EQBench3 than its competitors. It leverages realtime data from the X platform to provide uptotheminute insights, though it slightly trails Gemini and GPT in pure mathematical reasoning.[7][4]
 GPT5.2 (OpenAI): Released as a "code red" response to Gemini 3, GPT5.2 focuses on stability and speed for professional knowledge work. It remains a toptier generalist with high marks in document analysis, complex PDF processing, and balanced agentic coding performance.[2][5][12][10]
 Gemini 3 (Google): Gemini 3 Pro is currently regarded as the leader for largescale multimodal tasks and mathematical precision, scoring 95.0% on the AIME 2025 benchmark. Its primary advantage is its deep integration across Google's 2billionuser ecosystem and its industryleading context window size.[5][4][2][7]
